To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a neural network trained with character level contextual and a special garbage classes can be used to extract class probability distributions at every pixel succession and that the output of this scanning network can be decoded by HMM to provide character recognition.
we propose a segmentation free approach for text line recognition that is better than the state-of-the-art.

(a) a scanning neural network trained with class probabilities at every line scan pixel can be used as an effective segmentation-free text line recognition system; (b) this scanning neural network can also be used as a feature extractor that provides contextual information at every pixel succession; (c) the scanning neural network and the HMMs together provide an effective segmentation-free character recognition approach.

the problem of segmentation free text line OCR.

a neural network can be effectively used for segmentation free OCR.
